## 🚀 Próximos Pasos Recomendados

### En GitHub.com:

1. **Ir a Settings del repositorio:**
   ```
   https://github.com/HilarioSolera/GEPCP-Ferreteria-El-Pana/settings
   ```

2. **Actualizar Description:**
   ```
   Enterprise-grade HR & Payroll Management System built with .NET 8 and ASP.NET Core
   ```

3. **Agregar Topics:**
   ```
   dotnet, csharp, asp-net-core, payroll, human-resources, 
   sqlite, razor-pages, enterprise-application
   ```

4. **Hacer push de los cambios:**
   ```powershell
   git add .
   git commit -m "docs: add comprehensive English documentation for GitHub portfolio"
   git push origin master
   ```
